findings.title: No visible primary CTA in the hero
findings.evidence: The hero shows 'The all-new Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra | Fold8 | Flip8' with no button such as 'Pre-order', 'Learn more' or 'Buy now'. The only visible actions are the small header icons (search, cart, account) and the 'Shop' nav link. The CTA list above the fold also includes 'Shop Explore Shop', which looks like a duplicated or mislabeled item.
findings.fix: Add a prominent button pair under the headline, such as 'Pre-order now' (primary) and 'Learn more' (secondary). Use a high-contrast fill and put it within the first viewport. Clean up the duplicated 'Shop Explore Shop' label.
findings.impact: Visitors decide in seconds; unclear hierarchy and actions send them to a competitor.

findings.title: Hero lacks supporting context and trust or offer signals
findings.evidence: The right side is a large empty white area holding only a blue 'The all-new' line and the product names. There is no launch date, price, offer, trade-in, financing, delivery or warranty cue. No ratings, reviews or other reassurance appear above the fold. The H1 is just 'Samsung', which says nothing about the offer.
findings.fix: Add one line of value (e.g. 'Pre-order today and get up to ₹X off with trade-in') plus a small trust strip covering free delivery, 1-year warranty, EMI and secure payment. Make the H1 descriptive of the page.
findings.impact: Visitors decide in seconds; unclear hierarchy and actions send them to a competitor.

findings.title: Hero imagery is cropped and header utilities are tiny
findings.evidence: The phone image is cut off at the bottom and left edge, and the hand with two devices sits far from the text, leaving a big gap in the middle. The Support and For Business links in the top right are very small. The icon-only search, cart and account controls have no labels, and 'Log-In/Sign-Up' is not shown as text.
findings.fix: Frame the product fully and bring the copy and image closer together. Enlarge the utility links and add labels or tooltips to the icons, with a visible 'Sign in' text link.
findings.impact: Visitors decide in seconds; unclear hierarchy and actions send them to a competitor.
